sources.cite: TensorFlow, 'Get started with TensorFlow Data Validation'
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: validate_statistics 'matches the statistics of the dataset against the schema and marks any discrepancies'; a feature's presence is set by presence.min_fraction; out-of-domain values are anomalies; if it is a real data error 'the underlying data should be fixed before using it for training'; drift between training days is checked with drift_comparator and previous_statistics (Jensen-Shannon divergence covers numeric features). The pipeline's components and commands are the author's scenario on Agent Platform Pipelines (to verify the CLI).
